chunks: Not all of the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) were those who would ask him and seek clarification from him,
indeed, they would love for a Bedouin or a stranger to come and ask him (peace be upon him) so that they could listen.
Whenever any such thing came before me, I asked him about its meaning and preserved it.

key_terms.أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: companions of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali distinguish his approach to learning from the Prophet compared to other companions?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) distinguishes between the passive majority of companions, who were content to listen to inquiries from outsiders, and his own active pursuit of knowledge by questioning and memorizing the Prophet's teachings. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the necessity of diligent inquiry (istifham) and retention (hifz) to preserve the authenticity of the Sunnah against the potential dilution caused by passive companionship.
